articles.title: Crypto-backed PAC scales back ad spending in Massachusetts primary
articles.description: The $189,000 in media spending to support Representative Jake Auchincloss marked Fairshake’s latest attempt to influence the 2026 elections with funds from the crypto industry.

articles.title: Binance expands TradFi push with options on 1,000 US stocks, ETFs
articles.description: The launch gives eligible non-US users access to physically settled options on more than 1,000 US stocks and ETFs through a single Binance account.

articles.title: UK crime agency froze $13.5M amid probe into Premier League crypto sponsor
articles.description: UK authorities froze $13.5 million in cash following a January 2025 order from the Westminster Magistrates’ Court as part of an investigation into Sorare.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: SEC proposes broad update to decades-old transfer agent rules with blockchain nod
articles.description: The proposal would modernize rules largely unchanged since the 1980s, addressing blockchain-based recordkeeping, tokenized securities and increasingly automated market infrastructure.

articles.title: Kalshi issues first lifetime ban for Republican politician over insider bets
articles.description: The prediction platform permanently banned George Santos and issued a three-year suspension for Laurie Buckhout after investigations into using insider information on event contracts.

articles.title: BofA, Citi, Goldman Sachs among 21 institutions planning stablecoin launch
articles.description: The planned venture will initially focus on a US dollar stablecoin before expanding to other G7 currencies, with a euro-denominated offering next.

articles.title: Ethena launches USDe payments app, offers 6% rewards
articles.description: The self-custodial app brings USDe into everyday payments, savings and cross-border transfers, with annualized rewards of up to 6%.

articles.title: Bitcoin stays flat as global bond bear market rages on, pushing JGB to high
articles.description: Global bond yields hit multi-decade highs today as Japan’s 10-year JGB yield reached a 30-year peak, keeping Bitcoin steady near $78,000.

articles.title: Fake Claude desktop app spreads crypto-stealing malware
articles.description: RevStealer targets more than 50 crypto wallets alongside browser passwords, cookies, messaging data and selected documents.

articles.title: Does the Bitcoin rally mean we haven’t wasted our lives in crypto?
articles.description: Crypto is showing signs of life again, but its biggest wins look different from what early believers imagined. After a decade of building, has it all been worth it?

articles.title: Asia sees digital asset custody infrastructure deals from Ripple, Coincheck
articles.description: Ripple was among the latest blockchain companies to sign a strategic partnership to build more custody and tokenized asset management solutions for Asian institutional participants.

articles.title: Kast launches stablecoin-powered business platform after $80M raise
articles.description: Kast aims to onboard between 1,000 and 5,000 active businesses to its new platform by the end of 2026.

articles.title: Lazarus Group-linked addresses move $30M through Hyperliquid
articles.description: Crypto wallets linked to the OFAC-sanctioned Lazarus Group moved $30 million in digital assets through Hyperliquid, weeks after regulators said they were working on a path to introduce the exchange into US markets.

articles.title: London Stock Exchange partners with Kraken parent for tokenized UK stocks: FT
articles.description: The London bourse operator is seeking to offer 24/5 exposure to UK-based tokenized equities, as more TradFi institutions explore tokenized equities offerings.

articles.title: Bitfinex Securities lists tokenized notes tied to Strategy, Metaplanet
articles.description: Five equity-backed notes issued through Luxembourg’s ORO II fund will trade against dollars, USDT and Bitcoin for eligible non-US investors.

articles.title: Singapore weighs recognizing some foreign-issued stablecoins
articles.description: Singapore is considering allowing jointly issued cross-border stablecoins into its regulatory regime, revisiting its earlier decision to restrict the framework to domestic issuance.

articles.title: Trump Jr.-linked 1789 Capital leads Polymarket’s $1B raise: Report
articles.description: Donald Trump Jr.-linked 1789 Capital will reportedly lead a $1 billion investment round into Polymarket, which would value the platform at $21 billion, just below Kalshi’s $22 billion valuation.

articles.title: BlackRock drives $217M Bitcoin ETF rebound as altcoin funds continue streaks
articles.description: Ether ETFs extended their inflow streak to 11 trading sessions, while XRP and Solana funds each logged a 10th consecutive positive session.

articles.title: Thailand SEC proposes retail access to regulated overseas crypto derivatives
articles.description: Thailand’s SEC seeks comments on rules requiring retail-accessible overseas crypto derivatives to trade on qualifying, centrally cleared exchanges.

articles.title: Ireland excludes crypto from new tax-advantaged investment accounts
articles.description: Ireland’s planned investment accounts will offer tax benefits for stocks, bonds and ETFs, while excluding crypto and derivatives as higher-risk products.

articles.title: Webull expands crypto trading into Canada through Coinbase collaboration
articles.description: The brokerage is adding digital assets alongside stocks, ETFs and options as Canadian crypto ownership rises and regulators move toward clearer industry rules.

articles.title: Bitcoin begins volatile monthly close as US bond yields eye new 20-year high
articles.description: Bitcoin price action saw sharp moves within its local range as US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent addressed US bond yields.

articles.title: Bitmine now controls 4.9% of Ethereum supply after adding 53.5K ETH
articles.description: Bitmine has bought Ether for 65 consecutive weeks, maintaining its accumulation strategy through a prolonged crypto downturn and $5.1 billion in paper losses.

articles.title: Strive buys 1,800 Bitcoin for $143M, becomes fifth-biggest corporate holder
articles.description: Strive’s latest Bitcoin purchase lifted its holdings to 23,156 BTC, making it the fifth-largest publicly traded corporate holder as crypto markets rebound.

articles.title: Russian crypto trading to bring $46B to regulated exchanges in first year after legalization: Report
articles.description: Regulated cryptocurrency exchanges may see more than $46 billion in crypto trading volume during the first year after legalization, according to estimates from the country’s largest bank.

articles.title: Mystery surrounds why an OG burned $1M in Bitcoin
articles.description: The million dollar question is what prompted a Bitcoin OG to send 20 BTC to a custodian, retrieve it back, and then deliberately burn it?

articles.title: Japanese regulator requests tax filing exemption for trust-type stablecoins in 2027 reform
articles.description: Japan’s FSA requested to exempt trust-type stablecoins from mandatory tax filings starting in fiscal year 2027, arguing that it would improve their use as transaction tools.

articles.title: Metaplanet moves 4,800 BTC worth $377M to Coinbase
articles.description: The Japanese Bitcoin treasury company has transferred 10,270 BTC to Coinbase Prime this week, an amount equal to more than 29% of its reported holdings.

articles.title: Strategy buys $370M Bitcoin in first corporate purchase since June
articles.description: Strategy added to its BTC treasury for the first time in two months, while continuing to bolster its cash reserves and buy back its perpetual STRC preferred stock.
